name: ermine-data
description: Deterministic, semantically realistic data generator for the Ermine corpus databases (tracker/DB-PLAN.md, tracker/db/GENERATOR.md): (seed, tier, domain) -> CSV per table + manifest.

scripts.load:mssql: npm run --silent build && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning dist/src/load/cli.js mssql
scripts.load:sqlite: npm run --silent build && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning dist/src/load/cli.js sqlite
